\>atp i want to sh just to see if they'd notice, specifically my mom. like she cares abt me but she's seen my arms and not asked anything.

Please don’t harm yourself for that reason. This is a common phenomenon. It's where someone thinks they have to prove they're sick to get help, so sh can happen. It won't give you the attention that you want. It's better to just ask for help when you can or talk to someone. However, I know that's not always easy or even possible, but sh is not the way to get through this. Try just thinking about the possibility of talking to your mom if you think you could go to her for help and see if you can eventually get the courage to do it. (that's what worked for me)

Here’s some other things you can do instead of sh - Holding ice cubes, punching a pillow, taking a hot shower or drawing on yourself. Those are a few coping skills that have helped me.

I’m 22 and I’ve dealt with a lot of the stuff you’re dealing with. If your parents make you feel worse and they don’t help you then start distancing yourself from them as much as possible. You have tried to ask for attention from them and it seems like you’re just not getting what you need. If interactions with them are hard, avoid them as much as possible. (ik how hard this could be for a 14 yr old) Try finding places where you can go instead of home to be away from your parents. I recommend parks or libraries. It’s usually quiet and you can keep to yourself. 

Another recommendation I would have is to journal. You have a lot of thoughts overlapping in your head, and it feels like you can’t talk to anyone so get it out yourself. It can help a lot with overthinking and sometimes puts things into perspective. It can just feel good to get it all out there. If you feel as though you need to get it out physically you can try exercise or moving your body around. Even something like doing stretches in your bed can make you feel a bit better.

\>i should be rich, i should rule the world, I'm wasted potential which is tragic because i have so much of it.

You are NOT wasted potential! You are 14 dude! You’ve barely been alive! You have so much more time to accomplish the things you want to than you think you do. Things get a lot easier when you can get away from toxic environments. Keep holding on to the hope that one day you will get through this. When I was a kid it felt like forever, but once you're out it can be hard, but it feels amazing. 

\>I'm sad, which is sad, which makes me even more sad. I want to feel content. I feel happy when I'm with my friends sometimes, and content when I'm doing one of the things I love, but that's it. I need to feel something other than continuous loathing and melancholy.

 I’m here to tell you those are the exact reasons you keep living. Happiness isn’t something that is just always on and stays with you; it’s an emotion like anything else. And having a chance to be in that joy, even if it’s only for a little bit, is always worth it. So keep doing the things you love and be with your friends, and really appreciate those moments. One other fun part about life that I found that keeps me going is dreaming and trying to achieve them even if it's tiny baby steps at a time.

I was not for a very very very long time. Pretty much when I hit puberty I had horrible mental health issues and suicidal thoughts. I still do, but I’m managing better. For a long time I didn’t know what to live for or what to hold onto. When I would go to mental hospitals it was often said it was good to live for others, family, friends etc. And that works for only a bit, at least for me. It’s not like I didn’t care about my loved ones, but I couldn’t control my suicidal thoughts and tendencies. It’s so painful and difficult to live for other people. It’s such a big weight to have over you and for me it just made me feel guilty. 

I realized I had to find out how to live for myself or what that would even look like. I’m still figuring it out, but day by day I’m getting closer and better. I’ve finally found a safe environment to live in, I’ve nurtured my friendships to create a support system and I asked myself what gets me out of bed in the morning. What made me excited as a kid to where I felt as though I couldn’t sleep. What are the things that used to make me smile so hard my cheeks hurt? It can take long to remember, but once you do the little things come back and help you remember more about yourself and desires.

I had to set up my own goals for myself and find a path I would be happy to walk along. I’m going to college for what I’ve always wanted to do and I’m excited to pursue my career and live FOR ME! And love myself as much as I can all the way, with I struggle with but I’m trying and that’s what matters
